scope: Shared ingestion audit and indexer-status failure logging

behavior.audit_fallback: Owned-connection ingestion audit failures log only the exception class and remain best-effort.
behavior.status_fallback: Owned-connection indexer-status failures log only the exception class and remain best-effort.
behavior.cleanup: Owned connections still close on both failure paths; caller-owned connection failures still propagate.

coverage: secret-bearing audit insert error is redacted and owned connection closes
secret-bearing indexer-status error is redacted and owned connection closes

limitations: No database or provider was contacted.
Caller-owned database errors continue to propagate to the caller unchanged.
